title: Count Even Numbers
description: Given a slice of integers, return the number of even integers in the slice.
hints: Check whether each number is divisible by 2.
io_contract: CountEven(numbers) returns the number of integers in numbers that are divisible by 2. Negative even integers are included. An empty slice returns 0.
ambiguity_resolutions: Zero is an even integer and is included in the count.
An empty slice returns 0, not an error.
The input order does not affect the result.
